# Warp

> Distributed job processing, message queue, and in-memory mediator library for .NET 10. Three patterns, one unified pipeline, a real-time dashboard.

Warp ships as core packages — Moberg.Warp.Core (publishing; also includes always-on durable outbound webhook delivery), Moberg.Warp.Worker (processing), Moberg.Warp.UI (dashboard) — plus optional add-ons: Moberg.Warp.Http (exposes IRequest<T> / IStreamRequest<T> handlers as ASP.NET endpoints, and observes inbound calls to them), Moberg.Warp.Adapters.Http and Moberg.Warp.Adapters.Refit (observe outbound calls your app makes to other services). Supports PostgreSQL and SQL Server. Uses the transactional outbox pattern — jobs are committed atomically with your business data.

## Docs

- [Getting Started](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/getting-started): Installation, DbContext setup, service registration, first handler
- [Messages](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/patterns/messages): Pub/sub IMessage with multiple handlers, fan-out routing
- [Jobs](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/patterns/jobs): IJob with scheduling, retries, continuations, batches, named queues, mutex
- [Requests](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/patterns/requests): In-memory IRequest<TResponse> via IMediator.Send(), no persistence
- [Patterns Overview](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/patterns): Type hierarchy, unified pipeline behaviors
- [Outbox Pattern](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/features/outbox-pattern): Transactional outbox — jobs committed with business data
- [Recurring Jobs](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/features/recurring-jobs): Cron-based scheduling, deduplication, execution history
- [Job Metadata](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/features/metadata): Key-value metadata, publish pipeline behaviors, IJobContext
- [Mutex](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/features/mutex): ConcurrencyKey-based mutual exclusion for jobs
- [Semaphore](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/features/semaphore): Bounded concurrency (limit > 1) via [Semaphore], Wait/Skip policies
- [Timeout](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/features/timeout): Per-attempt / total deadlines, Delete vs Fail modes
- [Rate Limiting](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/features/rate-limit): Fixed / sliding / token-bucket styles, Skip vs Wait, per-key buckets
- [Circuit Breaker](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/features/circuit-breaker): Trip on failure threshold, half-open probe recovery
- [No-Restart](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/features/no-restart): [NoRestart] / [Restart] for non-idempotent work and stale-job recovery
- [Batched Completions](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/features/batched-completions): Coalesced completion writes for throughput
- [Sagas](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/features/sagas): Correlated stateful workflows, [Correlate] / [StartsSaga], delete-on-completion
- [Background Services](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/features/background-services): WarpBackgroundService supervisor loops, PerServer / Singleton lease scope
- [Database Push](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/features/db-push): LISTEN/NOTIFY & Service Broker wake-up, opt-in low-latency pickup
- [Dashboard Push](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/features/dashboard-push): SignalR realtime dashboard updates
- [DB-Generated IDs](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/features/db-generated-ids): Database-assigned identifiers
- [Job Cancellation](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/features/cancellation): Graceful CancellationMode, handler CancellationToken, transitive batch cancel
- [Pause / Resume](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/features/pause): Pause servers and worker groups, resume processing
- [Job Tracing](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/features/tracing): TraceId and SpawnedByJobId for cross-job flow visibility
- [HTTP Endpoints](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/features/http): Expose IRequest<T> / IStreamRequest<T> handlers as ASP.NET endpoints via [WarpHttp...] on handler classes (inbound)
- [Endpoint Observability](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/features/endpoint-observability): Observe inbound requests to your Warp HTTP endpoints — caller, duration, status, bodies (AddEndpointObservability)
- [Outbound Adapters](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/features/adapters): Observe outbound calls to other services, cluster-shared rate limiting, capture on failure (AddAdapters)
- [Durable Webhooks](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/features/webhooks): Durable outbound webhook delivery — retries, signing, redelivery, exhaustion (built into Core, always on; AddWebhooks only for optional custom signer / exhausted-handler)
- [Configuration](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/operations/configuration): Worker, polling, retention (age + count), dispatcher mode, worker groups, schema, naming conventions
- [EF Core Integration](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/operations/ef-core-integration): DbContext setup, server-internal context, migrations, naming conventions
- [Crash Recovery](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/operations/crash-recovery): Sliding invisibility timeout, keep-alive, stale job recovery
- [Dashboard Auth](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/operations/dashboard-auth): MapWarpUI + RequireAuthorization, built-in cookie login, localhost-only
- [Releases](https://moberghr.github.io/warp/docs/releases): Version history and upgrade notes

## Optional
